title: Exploring Interspeaker Variation in Creaky Voice in Dutch
why_promising: 30 Dutch male speakers; 1,093 manually segmented and subtype-annotated creaky intervals; at least 1,500 syllables per speaker; acoustic measures include f0, CPP and spectral-balance/voice-quality measures.
open_question: Underlying recordings are secondary reuse of the Spoken Dutch Corpus, so core admission is prohibited unless the genuinely new manual creak annotations/measurements are publicly deposited and can be isolated with recording lineage. Locate public annotation/measurement files; do not ingest CGN audio as primary.
